description: This Java class defines the configuration for a MongoDB database connection within a service. It encapsulates various settings such as maximum query time, URI, connection pool, circuit breaker, monitoring, and options. Includes methods to create instances from a configuration object, and overrides standard methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultMongoDbConfig
classes.description: Immutable class providing configuration for MongoDB, including URI, query timeout, connection pooling, circuit breaker, and monitoring settings.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultMongoDbConfig from a given Config object, applying fallback values and determining the MongoDB URI.

methods.name: getMaxQueryTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed query duration.

methods.name: getMongoDbUri
methods.description: Returns the MongoDB URI used for connections.

methods.name: getOptionsConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration related to MongoDB options.
